description: Queensland Roads and Tracks is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Department of Resources, QLD. Queensland Roads and Tracks is the Department of Resources' foundation dataset of road data. It is a vector (line segment) dataset depicting the approximal centreline location and attributes of roads and tracks across Queensland. It does not replicate a navigable product. Coverage is Queensland, 2020 to 2021; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as daily, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
